snippet.title: Just Keep Waddling - Trailer
snippet.description:
Check the game out on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4147340/Just_Keep_Waddling_Nihilist_Penguin/

Just Keep Waddling is an atmospheric minimalist walking game where you play as a penguin with one simple goal: reach the mountain. Enjoy the journey, take in the mood, and see how you stack up on the global leaderboard.

This is a little side project from our main game, enjoy!

Created by BrickSideStudio.

Trailer music composed by Andrew J. Kim.

#gamedev #indiegame #steamgame #penguin #walkingsimulator
